name: Internal monthly close and reconciliation workbook

patterns_used: Separate source populations by originating module and retain system-like field order.
Use a small close-preparation/control tab beside raw export tabs.
Vary row density by population instead of normalizing every sheet.
foundation_lineage.transformation_boundary: Reuse only the reviewed abstract workbook organization; rebuild every fact, identifier, value, formula, and style from the authorized new world.

purpose: Reconcile source-system activity to the general ledger and prepare supported close entries.
medium: Native Excel workbook assembled from ERP exports and analyst schedules
lifecycle: Working copy through reviewed close file

authority.governing_scope: Supports reconciliation and proposed close entries within the stated close period.
authority.non_governing_scope: Does not replace the general ledger, approved policy, or executed authorization.

authorized_inputs: Approved fictional-world general ledger and close calendar
source_boundary.conflict_resolution: The approved fictional-world ledger governs amounts; unresolved source differences remain explicit exceptions.

natural_depth: Raw ERP exports with repeated fields and dormant records
Exception log, review checks, and source index
footprint.source_owned_rationale: The tab and row ranges arise from separate ERP populations, mapping needs, reconciliation work, and controller review rather than a page quota.

sequence: Controller reviews checks and proposed entries

prohibited: Every tab sharing one presentation style

proof_gates.procedure: Tie source populations, mapped totals, ledger balances, and proposed entries.
Render and inspect every populated sheet and print area.
Inspect properties, hidden content, comments, names, links, and external connections.
Recalculate every formula and verify material totals and error states.
Trace every input population to the approved fictional-world source manifest.
Scan visible and hidden content for prior-world, generator, and evaluation residue.
Confirm supporting work is distinct from governing ledger and approvals.
Map every tab and material range to a producer-owned close workflow purpose.
